# @thednp/domparser

> A lightweight TypeScript HTML parser for isomorphic applications. Provides a fast Parser (~1.5kB), a full DomParser with selectors and DOM manipulation (~4.1kB), and a Document-like creation API (~2.6kB). Zero runtime dependencies.

`@thednp/domparser` parses HTML into a DOM tree with a chunking strategy (64KB chunks) for memory safety. It handles malformed HTML, self-closing tags, CDATA, comments, and script/style content limits. The DomParser adds CSS selector queries (`querySelector`, `getElementById`, etc.), attribute manipulation, and node tree operations. Unlike jsdom or cheerio, it focuses on essential DOM features for dramatically better performance.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/README.md): Full API reference with examples for Parser, DomParser, and DOM creation
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes

## Source

- [Main entry](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/index.ts): Re-exports all public API components
- [Tokenizer and utilities](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/util.ts): HTML tokenizer with chunking, attribute parser, type guards
- [TypeScript types](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/types.ts): All type definitions for nodes, options, and results
- [Lightweight Parser](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/parser.ts): Fast DOM tree creation without DOM API
- [DomParser](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/dom-parser.ts): Full DOM-like parser with filtering and validation
- [DOM prototype](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/prototype.ts): Node creation, tree manipulation, serialization, selector integration
- [Selector engine](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/src/parts/selectors.ts): CSS selector matching with LRU cache (100 entries)
- [Tests](https://github.com/thednp/domparser/blob/master/test/index.test.ts): 100% coverage test suite
